name: book-workflow
description: 知识蒸馏闭环工作流：cangjie-skill 拆书生成 → svg-diagram 房规出图 → dsh 三闸+图件闸逐字回源审计 → 判态放行或回炉。桥接器给能力卡 R 层引文铸稳定池 id 并逐字回源原始书文；四闸（池覆盖/锚一致/证据闭包/图件）全绿才允许 compile 编译交付，红项按映射表回炉对应阶段。按工作区自举（.venv + 闸门套装），审计全本地零 API 成本；vendor 四件随包自包含（cangjie v2.5.0-refresh / dsh v4.9.26 / svg-diagram c30c9e3 / html-css-to-image v0.3.0，后者仅显式栅格出图且有密钥时调用，不进四闸）。

description_i18n.en: Closed-loop book distillation workflow: cangjie-skill generation, svg-diagram house-style figures, then dsh verbatim source-back auditing with four gates (pool coverage, anchor consistency, evidence closure, diagram lint). Bridge mints stable pool ids for every R-layer quote and verifies each verbatim against the original book text. Compile only after all gates pass; red findings route back to the matching stage. Per-workspace bootstrap, fully local audit at zero API cost; four vendors bundled (cangjie v2.5.0-refresh / dsh v4.9.26 / svg-diagram c30c9e3 / html-css-to-image v0.3.0). The image client is opt-in, key-gated, and not a gate.
